entries.title: Show HN: GPT-4-powered web searches for developers
entries.author: rushingcreek
entries.current_title: Show HN: GPT-4-powered web searches for developers
entries.excerpt: Hi HN, Today we’re launching GPT-4 answers on Phind.com, a developer-focused search engine that uses generative AI to browse the web and answer technical questions, complete with code examples and detailed explanations. Unlike vanilla GPT-4, Phind feeds in relevant websites and technical documentation, reducing the model’s hallucination and keeping it up-to-date. To use it, simply enable the “Expert” toggle before doing a search. GPT-4 is making a night-and-day difference in
entries.guide_zh: Phind 为开发者搜索引入 GPT-4，并结合网页和文档生成回答。

entries.title: Show HN: Tabby – A Self-Hosted GitHub Copilot
entries.author: wsxiaoys
entries.current_title: Show HN: Tabby – A self-hosted GitHub Copilot
entries.excerpt: I would like to introduce Tabby, which is a self-hosted alternative to GitHub Copilot that you can integrate into your hardware. While GitHub Copilot has made coding more efficient and less time-consuming by assisting developers with suggestions and completing code, it raises concerns around privacy and security. Tabby is in its early stages, and we are excited to receive feedback from the community. Its Github repository is located here: https://github.com/TabbyML/tabby . We
entries.guide_zh: Tabby 提供可自行托管的代码辅助工具，尝试替代 GitHub Copilot。

entries.title: Show HN: ScrapScript – The Sharable Programming Language
entries.author: surprisetalk
entries.current_title: Show HN: ScrapScript – A tiny functional language for sharable software
entries.excerpt: Hi friends, I started casually working on scrapscript in 2015. I built a few compilers over the years to test out various ideas/implementations, and I think I'm finally happy with the overall design. The code is not public yet. Email me at hello@taylor.town if you're interested in joining the core team later this year. Let me know if you have any questions or feedback :)
entries.guide_zh: ScrapScript 以可分享为目标设计编程语言，作者介绍多年探索后的方案。
